scope: Targeted property tests verifying Project-Join Normal Form (5NF), Non-Binary Chase Confluence, Darwen-Date-Fagin Spurious Tuple Witness, and SKNF Separation

properties_verified.details: Verified on Fagin SPJ schema and Darwen-Date-Fagin Theorem 6.1: 4-tuple parity instance generates 4 spurious tuples under ternary join, showing SKNF does not entail 5NF.
Verified that permuting functional dependency execution order preserves tableau cell partitions identically across ternary, quaternary, and 5-way decompositions (RULE_NORMAL_FORMS_CHASE_001).
Verified 5NF sufficient condition: candidate keys logically imply join dependencies when every component contains a candidate key, subsuming Heath and Fagin binary joins.
Verified strict relational hierarchy: 1NF -> 2NF -> 3NF -> BCNF -> 4NF -> 5NF with separating counterexamples.
Verified tabular relation projection-join reconstruction, spurious tuple witness generation, AST parsing, and YAML contract validation against the Standard.
